sed_engine: GNU sed, Git for Windows; stdin/stdout only; restricted expressions
method_limitations: Only direct sed/cp statements are parsed; dynamic commands and shell branches are not executed.
Every sed command is probed independently on pristine firmware bytes, not on a complete installed state.
No-change can be an expected already-installed/cleanup/alternate-branch case.
GNU sed and modern JavaScript parsing do not prove BusyBox/Opera runtime compatibility.
Copy analysis covers locally available, statically resolvable payload paths only.
No patch is approved for use on the vehicle by this audit.
